cases.A: new event -> coverage updated -> snapshot no change -> non-report day -> assessment pending
cases.B: new event changes deterministic snapshot field -> candidate -> validator pass -> auto activate
cases.C: new event touches analytical snapshot field -> review_required -> no auto activation -> assessment blocked
cases.D: new event published but coverage rebuild fails -> facts stay -> old coverage stays -> refresh failed
cases.E: coverage succeeds, snapshot staging fails -> coverage retained -> active snapshot unchanged
cases.F: snapshot commit interrupted -> journal detected -> recovery -> exactly one active
cases.G: snapshot succeeds, mock assessment fails -> no snapshot rollback -> trigger retry
cases.H: report day + full coverage -> mock assessment final format generated
cases.I: report day + incomplete coverage -> draft_with_data_gap -> no formal delivery
cases.J: duplicate consumption of same refresh request -> no duplicate coverage/snapshot/trigger
cases.K: new facts in same period -> old pending trigger superseded
cases.L: refresh request after publication rollback -> consumption rejected
